0022600007.text: The Denver Nuggets open their 2026-27 season at the Oklahoma City Thunder, who are 1-0 and first in the Northwest Division and the West, with a 1-0 road record. Denver is without Julian Strawther, who is out with a knee sprain, while Spencer Jones is day-to-day with a hamstring injury and is a game-time decision. Oklahoma City is missing Otega Oweh, who is out after Achilles surgery, and Nikola Topic and Thomas Sorber, who are both day-to-day and game-time decisions with back and knee surgery recoveries. The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Nuggets lost the season series 1-3, though Denver won 127-107 in Denver in their most recent meeting on April 10.
